package.name: jaka_single_arm
package.description:
Industrial-grade single-arm pick-and-place framework for JAKA C5. Architecture inspired by jaka_dual_arm — layered design with perception abstraction, object detection, PlannerServer, SceneManager, Skills, and BehaviorTree orchestration.
Reference open-source projects: - ros2_moveit2_ur5e_grasp (Nackustb) — modular vision + MoveIt2 + OctoMap - mycobot_ros2 (AutomaticAddison) — PCL segmentation + MTC - ros2_grasp_library (happyhorse0707) — OpenVINO CNN grasp detection
package.author: hydarealman
